src/lib/components/Tabulator.react.js.description:
A thin Dash wrapper around Tabulator: header filters, grouped headers,
row grouping, totals, sparkline cells and a reset action.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

columns.description: Tabulator column definitions; nested `columns` create grouped headers.

groupBy.description: Field name or ordered list of field names for row grouping.

height.description: Fixed grid height. Ignored when `maxHeight` is set.

maxHeight.description: Grow with the rows up to this height, then scroll.

movableColumns.description: Allow dragging columns to reorder them.

resetToken.description: Change this value to clear filters/sorts and restore the declared columns and grouping.

filterState.description: Read-only: the current filters, including header filters.

eventData.description: Read-only: the latest table event, e.g. {type: "dataFiltered", rowCount}.

className.description: Extra CSS class for the container.
